asIs.title: FP&A Commercial As-Is Process Map
asIs.html:
Demand to Profit · FP&A Commercial · Stages 1-9 of the Commercial FP&A E2E (simplified v3) and CAPEX planning · LT feedback applied 15 Oct 2026

FP&A Commercial As-Is Process Map

From Brand Manager revenue assumptions to the signed-off P&L and its control attestation: revenue, manpower, non-manpower and CAPEX planning, P&L consolidation and PMR submission with CMR validation, the planning deck, pre-close analysis, monthly revenue and cost reporting, the mid-month forecast and the FCF controls in FAST+. Pain points and activity types reflect the updated As-Is map reviewed with FP&A Commercial.

Owner FP&A Commercial (GFS KL) with CP, CFO, BUDs, Brand Managers, HR, Embedded Finance and InternationalCadence Annual plan cycles (RBU, MTP, Budget); monthly pre-close, reporting, mid-month forecast and FCF attestationCore systems Excel on SharePoint, SAP (MM60, FBL3N, GD13), PMR / CMR, AZ FORCE, Cost Tool, CAS (CAPEX), Power BI, FAST+, OneGRC

asIs.title: Pain points 55
asIs.html:
Pain points 55

As documented by FP&A Commercial in the E2E v3, the CAPEX planning summary and the updated As-Is feedback, grouped by stage · red ! on the map marks the step; [CHALLENGE] nodes below each stage list them.

Stage 1: Revenue Planning by SKU and Brand10
Data quality & completeness: manual SKU validation against SAP master data creates risk of omissionsRevenue Planning · step 1
Excel template (>15 MB, VBA) degrades and throws formula errors; no version control; corruption would disrupt the cycleRevenue Planning · step 2
Lack of automation: Excel file degrades with excessive formulas; slow and prone to formula errorsRevenue Planning · step 2
No automated version control: manual file backups used as workaroundRevenue Planning · step 2
Key risk: template corruption could disrupt the entire planning cycleRevenue Planning · step 2
Re-actualisation required when resubmission is needed because of long timelines between planning and area r...Revenue Planning · step 3
Re-actualisation required when resubmission is needed because of long timelines between planning and area reviewRevenue Planning · step 3
Manual copy-paste from Excel to PowerPoint for the reporting packageRevenue Planning · step 7
At least three revision cycles before final PMR submissionRevenue Planning · step 7
Delays and idle time from alignment and scenario discussionsRevenue Planning · step 8
Stage 2: Manpower (MPC), Non-Manpower (NMPC) & CAPEX Planning14
FTE by Brand templates consume disproportionate effortMPC Planning (Manpower Cost Planning) · step 1
AZ FORCE missing data at actualisation; new cost centres unavailableMPC Planning (Manpower Cost Planning) · step 5
Data quality: AZ FORCE frequently has missing data during actualisation; newly created cost centres often unavailable for planningMPC Planning (Manpower Cost Planning) · step 5
AZ FORCE review layout is not user-friendly, so output review is done in ExcelMPC Planning (Manpower Cost Planning) · step 6
BUD / HR / Finance misalignment delays conclusion; MPC revised when operating profit misses targetMPC Planning (Manpower Cost Planning) · step 9
Cost template preparation needs copying past cycles and matching actualsNMPC Planning (Non-Manpower Cost Planning) · step 1
Template preparation is not straightforward: copying past cycle details, matching against actuals, careful scrutiny and total checksNMPC Planning (Non-Manpower Cost Planning) · step 1
Data quality: duplicated data in actuals / planning where multiple lines with the same GL / CC combination were created in previous cyclesNMPC Planning (Non-Manpower Cost Planning) · step 1
Duplicated GL / cost centre lines from previous cyclesNMPC Planning (Non-Manpower Cost Planning) · step 3
Cost Tool macros fail and need the tool ownerNMPC Planning (Non-Manpower Cost Planning) · step 4
Key risk: heavy reliance on the Cost Tool with multiple macro functions; a macro crash needs significant troubleshootingNMPC Planning (Non-Manpower Cost Planning) · step 4
Repetitive rework every time changes happenNMPC Planning (Non-Manpower Cost Planning) · step 8
Pending input from the business (primary pain point)CAPEX Planning · step 2
Delays sometimes come from CBP; sometimes CBP inputs directly into the templateCAPEX Planning · step 3
Stage 3: P&L Planning & Total Company Consolidation6
Formula / macro errors on a >15-tab model linked to 20-30 files; key-person dependency; market template variationsP&L Planning · step 2
Formula or macro errors on the >15-tab, ~10 MB file linked to 20 to 30 stakeholder files take significant analyst time to root-causeP&L Planning · step 2
Key risk: key-person dependency; the back-up (manager) takes time to learn the file structureP&L Planning · step 2
Minor standardisation variations (e.g. Malaysia BUD combines CVRM and central TA such as Nexium) need manual template adjustmentP&L Planning · step 2
Wrong SCC / royalty ratesP&L Planning · step 3
VBA macro re-run for every input (~1 hour lag, 4-5 iterations)P&L Planning · step 4
Stage 4: Planning System Submission & PMR-CMR Validation6
Key risk: dependency on timely and accurate Embedded Finance inputsPlanning System Submission · step 1
Manual Gross Margin Pay Away calculation and phasing inputPlanning System Submission · step 4
Master data issues at upload (new cost centre missing in PMR)Planning System Submission · step 5 +1
Heavy manual consolidation and reconciliation across Excel files and systemsPlanning System Submission · step 6 +1
30 min - 1 hr PMR-CMR bridge lag per iterationPlanning System Submission · step 12
Frequent rework loops; key-person riskPlanning System Submission · step 14 +1
Stage 5: Planning Deck Preparation & Leadership Review4
International templates with formula errors or outdated structures; late distributionPlanning Review Preparation (Planning Deck Preparation) · step 1
Delays typically originate from late distribution of materials from InternationalPlanning Review Preparation (Planning Deck Preparation) · step 1
Error checking of international templates; format misaligned with the deckPlanning Review Preparation (Planning Deck Preparation) · step 2
Repeated refresh and copy-paste into PowerPoint every time numbers changePlanning Review Preparation (Planning Deck Preparation) · step 3
Stage 6: Pre-Close Analysis4
SAP data changes frequently and needs close monitoring for alignment with month-end expectationsPre-close Analysis · step 1
Delayed replies from budget owners on variance queries slow the processPre-close Analysis · step 3
Delays when requested correction journals are not booked in timePre-close Analysis · step 3 +1
Key risk: if not done correctly, the reported monthly numbers are inaccurate and may lead to wrong business decisionsPre-close Analysis · step 7
Stage 7: Monthly Revenue & Cost Reporting3
Highly manual multi-source consolidation (SAP, CMR, offline file)Revenue Reporting · step 2 +1
Key risk: heavily manual nature creates exposure to undetected human errorRevenue Reporting · step 13 +1
Market-specific granularity limits standardisation scopeRevenue Reporting · step 13
Stage 8: Mid-Month / Rolling Forecast4
Coincides with month-end close peak; actuals change after WD1Mid-Month Forecast (MMF) · step 1
Data quality: actual sales can continue to change after WD1; early template distribution may give mismatched actualsMid-Month Forecast (MMF) · step 1
Sales forecast collection from BUDs is entirely manual; no online platformMid-Month Forecast (MMF) · step 2
Multiple changes and rework in the sales forecast are routineMid-Month Forecast (MMF) · step 2
Stage 9: FCF Control Attestation via FAST+4
Missing / incomplete / inconsistent evidenceFCF Control on Revenue and P&L (FAST+) · step 1 +1
Manual evidence compilation at submissionFCF Control on Revenue and P&L (FAST+) · step 1
Manual OneGRC upload post-approval (workaround); system limitationsFCF Control on Revenue and P&L (FAST+) · step 12
Impact: missed or late approvals mean the control cannot be evidenced as performed, creating audit / compliance and control-failure exposureFCF Control on Revenue and P&L (FAST+) · step 12

ai.title: AI opportunities 21
ai.html:
AI opportunities 21

Shown as blue nodes on the map · Claude recommendations · hypotheses to validate with FP&A Commercial
Process ImprovementPlanning calendar with agreed cut-offs per market
Key process · Stage 1: Revenue Planning by SKU and Brand · FPAC-01

Fix the revenue planning calendar and cut-offs with the market after the Business Strategy Meetings, reducing idle time between alignment discussions.

AIAI baseline volume per SKU for Brand Managers
Process · Stage 1: Revenue Planning by SKU and Brand · Revenue Planning · FPAC-01.01

A statistical baseline per SKU from the phased actuals is pre-filled for Brand Managers, who adjust it with their assumptions; fewer revision cycles start from a blank template.

DigitalizationOne planning intake for MPC, NMPC and CAPEX
Key process · Stage 2: Manpower (MPC), Non-Manpower (NMPC) & CAPEX Planning · FPAC-02

One SharePoint / Power Apps intake hub for brand FTE, cost centre and CAPEX inputs with shared reminders and a status view for FP&A and Market Finance.

Process ImprovementBrand-level FTE field in AZ FORCE
Process · Stage 2: Manpower (MPC), Non-Manpower (NMPC) & CAPEX Planning · MPC Planning (Manpower Cost Planning) · FPAC-02.01

Raise a change request for brand-level FTE input in AZ FORCE, so brand allocation is captured in the planning system instead of a side Excel collection.

AIAI anomaly screening of cost centre inputs
Process · Stage 2: Manpower (MPC), Non-Manpower (NMPC) & CAPEX Planning · NMPC Planning (Non-Manpower Cost Planning) · FPAC-02.02

A model trained on prior cycles and actuals flags unusual cost lines before the FP&A review, focusing the review loop.

DigitalizationCAPEX planning tool with an embedded approval flow
Process · Stage 2: Manpower (MPC), Non-Manpower (NMPC) & CAPEX Planning · CAPEX Planning · FPAC-02.03

The improvement named in the CAPEX planning summary: one tool for business input, CBP review, CFO approval and the Region submission, replacing template cascades by email.

Process ImprovementReduce the key-person dependency on the master P&L model
Key process · Stage 3: P&L Planning & Total Company Consolidation · FPAC-03

Document the model (tab map, inputs vs logic, run steps) and rotate a trained back-up through each cycle.

AIAI-drafted P&L bridge between iterations
Process · Stage 3: P&L Planning & Total Company Consolidation · P&L Planning · FPAC-03.01

Copilot drafts the bridge between P&L iterations (what changed by brand and P&L line, and why) for the CFO / CP alignment.

Process ImprovementAgreed input cut-off with Embedded Finance
Key process · Stage 4: Planning System Submission & PMR-CMR Validation · FPAC-04

A fixed cut-off for Embedded Finance files per iteration, with changes after it going to the next iteration.

AutomationOne validation suite for the PMR submission
Process · Stage 4: Planning System Submission & PMR-CMR Validation · Planning System Submission · FPAC-04.01

Conso Check, PMR load, PMR vs Analytics and PMR vs CMR run as one scripted suite per iteration with a single exceptions report.

Process ImprovementDeck-aligned international template released on a fixed date
Key process · Stage 5: Planning Deck Preparation & Leadership Review · FPAC-05

Agree with International Finance a locked template that matches the deck, released on a fixed date per cycle.

AICopilot draft of the deck narrative
Process · Stage 5: Planning Deck Preparation & Leadership Review · Planning Review Preparation (Planning Deck Preparation) · FPAC-05.01

Copilot drafts the key messages per slide from the refreshed numbers for FP&A to edit.

Process ImprovementRoot-cause log of correction requests
Key process · Stage 6: Pre-Close Analysis · FPAC-06

Log pre-close correction requests by root cause (wrong cost centre, missing accrual, wrong period) and share a monthly summary with the booking teams, so repeat errors are prevented.

Process ImprovementBring known accruals into the pre-close view
Process · Stage 6: Pre-Close Analysis · Pre-close Analysis · FPAC-06.01

Late costs advised informally by Embedded Finance and known accrual lists show as expected postings, so fewer variances need a query.

Process ImprovementStandard revenue and cost output structure across markets
Key process · Stage 7: Monthly Revenue & Cost Reporting · FPAC-07

Agree a common core structure for the revenue and cost outputs with market-specific add-ons, so scripts and dashboards can be reused.

AutomationPython build of the 37-tab revenue master
Process · Stage 7: Monthly Revenue & Cost Reporting · Revenue Reporting · FPAC-07.01

One scripted run builds the revenue master from SAP and CMR extracts with the reconciliation, rules and checks above.

DigitalizationSAP-CMR reconciliation page on the RLS dashboard
Process · Stage 7: Monthly Revenue & Cost Reporting · Cost Reporting · FPAC-07.02

Show the SAP vs CMR reconciliation and stale FX / uplift values on the cost dashboard, so discrepancies are visible to everyone using it.

Process ImprovementDecouple forecast collection from the month-end peak
Key process · Stage 8: Mid-Month / Rolling Forecast · FPAC-08

Start BUD collection on a flash of prior-month sales and refresh actuals once final, so MMF does not collide with month-end close.

AIAI baseline sales forecast for BUD review
Process · Stage 8: Mid-Month / Rolling Forecast · Mid-Month Forecast (MMF) · FPAC-08.01

A run-rate and seasonality baseline per brand is pre-filled so BUDs forecast the delta, reducing routine rework.

Process ImprovementStandard evidence pack per FSC control
Key process · Stage 9: FCF Control Attestation via FAST+ · FPAC-09

Define the minimum evidence set for FSC008, FSC009 and FSC011 as a checklist in FAST+ across the 14 markets.

DigitalizationPower BI control status across 14 markets
Process · Stage 9: FCF Control Attestation via FAST+ · FCF Control on Revenue and P&L (FAST+) · FPAC-09.01

Submission, approval, delegation and OneGRC upload status by market and control (FSC008, FSC009, FSC011) in one view.

ai.title: AI opportunities 18
ai.html:
AI opportunities 18

Shown as blue nodes on the map · Claude recommendations · hypotheses to validate with FP&A Ops
Process ImprovementOne planning calendar and exception view across the six Operational Planning streams
Key process · Operational Planning · FPAO-02

Volume & COGM, logistics, workforce & OPEX, CAPEX, product costing and inventory share one calendar of loads and sign-offs and one exception view, so the stretch timeline and the multiple information feeds are managed centrally.

Process · Operational Planning · Operations Planning – Volume & Cost of Goods Manufactured modelling · G02

The OPS Cube COGM calculation is scheduled after the final volume load with a completion and FMC-gap report to the named ESM COGM owner, EF and the GFS SME.

DigitalizationLogistics planning driver model shared with GLF
Process · Operational Planning · Global Logistic & Warehouse · G03

Primary and secondary distribution drivers (rates, volumes, DC capacity, savings) in one governed model used by the APAC and GLF reviews, so the consolidation reviews work from the same assumptions.

Process ImprovementAZForce and OPS Cube actualisation on one FX version
Process · Operational Planning · Workforce & OPEX Planning · G04

Align the actualisation timing and exchange-rate version between AZForce and Ops Cube Hyperion so artificial USD variances no longer need repeated manual correction.

AutomationInventory planning exceptions dashboard
Process · Operational Planning · Inventory Planning · G07

Mapping gaps, price gaps, BPP-to-Planning-Hub differences and provision anomalies on one Power BI page for the Inventory team, EF and GSC&S Finance.

AutomationCost-base handover from Planning Hub to the costing run
Process · Operational Planning · Product Costing (FMC & SCC) · G06

Site and Global Quality expenses, Central OH and distribution and warehouse costs are passed to PC CoE as a reconciled extract from Planning Hub rather than assembled by hand.

AIRegional-level Q&A agent supported by site packs
Key process · P&L Modelling & Forecasting · FPAO-03

A Copilot agent supported by the site packs answers regional-level questions, with the relevant business insights stored in a central repository as a reference data source.

AutomationProductivity bridge pre-filled from OPS Cube
Process · P&L Modelling & Forecasting · Productivity Planning & Cost per Unit · G08

The CY / CY+1 bridge opens pre-filled with the COGM and M&O movements from Planning Hub and the ESM component values, leaving the drivers and initiatives for the site to complete.

DigitalizationSite pack and Steerco tracker on linked data
Process · P&L Modelling & Forecasting · Site P&L and Review Packs · G09

The site output pack and the planning activity tracker read the planning systems directly, so the pack refreshes with the numbers and the Steerco sees live adherence.

AIReview-cycle assistant extending Agent Charlie
Key process · Planning Review and Sign-Off · FPAO-04

Agent Charlie in Copilot Studio also tracks review actions and post-review adjustments across sites and drafts the follow-up list after each review.

AIAgent Charlie for the planning review cycle
Process · Planning Review and Sign-Off · Planning Review and Sign-Off (Site → Region → Group) · G10

Agent Charlie gives the site cheat sheets for the site reviews and the regional headline by cost category for the regional packs, with the analysts validating every draft (register RHY-05, RHY-06).

Cross-Tower CollaborationCoupa accrual lines enriched with PO text for Ops
Key process · Month-End Actualization · FPAO-05

R2R passes the PO text with the Coupa accrual JE posting so the Ops analyst can explain the accrual variances; raised as a cross-tower request with R2R and P2P.

AIRule-based variance extraction with AI first-layer review
Process · Variance Analysis · Variance Analysis vs Budget / RBU · G12

Variances are extracted by rule from the governed dashboards, screened for anomalies and stored as a driver table, so the analyst's time goes to explaining drivers (register FPA-10, RHY-12, RHY-17).

Cross-Tower CollaborationVolume commentary pulled forward to WD+1 with Global Supply Chain
Key process · Performance Reporting · FPAO-07

GFS sends the key brands to NSP on WD-4, NSP inputs by end WD-1 and GFS drafts for site finance on WD+2, with a threshold or Pareto rule for the brands needing commentary (register RHY-22, RHY-23, RHY-24).

AIAI-assisted commentary with guardrails and evidence check
Process · Performance Reporting · Commentary Preparation · G13

First-pass commentary drafted from the driver table, captured through Power Apps, checked against the dashboard measures and approved by the responsible reviewer under documented guardrails (register FPA-09, FPA-12, FPA-13, FPA-23).

Process · Performance Reporting · MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional) · G14

A hardened Rhy run (completeness, version guard, trigger, totals check, run log) with the pattern offered to other Ops regions and to towers that summarise many documents (register RHY-28, RHY-32).

AILeadership Q&A agent over the MI Pack and Flash
Key process · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · FPAO-08

A Copilot agent grounded on the approved regional MI Pack and Flash lets leadership ask questions on movements and risks with evidence from the pack.

Process ImprovementEarlier APAC view for the Global Ops close
Process · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · G16

The automated regional consolidation supports the Global Ops close at WD+6 in 2026 and WD+5 in 2027, on the path to WD+3 by 2030 (register RHY-25).

Manpower and non-manpower analysis runs on the governed Site Cost & FTE dashboard (automated SAP extraction, multi-comparator views) with unattended scheduling and AI anomaly flags for the first-layer review (register FPA-01, 02, 06, 07, 08, 10).		Site Cost & FTE dashboard (Power BI); Python; Power AutomateSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredAutomating the SAP data extraction and replacing the manual ASO retrieve with FDH is under exploration; the data reconciliation is already automated (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
40Variance Analysis · Variance Analysis vs Budget / RBU · step 5Step change · AutomationProvision and write-off analysis from the SOAR report by rule
The inventory provision and write-off movements are extracted and compared with the comparator and the EF provisioning review by script, with the local planner inputs captured on a list.		Python; SOAR inventory provision report; SharePoint listManual → AutomatedImplementedOngoing project to introduce the Actual Inventory Write-off and Provision Dashboard (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
41Variance Analysis · Variance Analysis vs Budget / RBU · step 6Step change · AIVariance screening and driver table shared with the FP&A P&L project
One rule set screens drivers above the threshold across all P&L lines and stores site, category, value, direction, driver and timing tag in a monthly table, so the conclusion is built on a consistent driver list and Power BI shows repeat drivers (register RHY-17, RHY-29, FPA-10).		Python; Power BI; SharePoint listSemi-automated → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityIncorporate the variance screening and driver table in the AI agent that generates the draft MI Pack commentary (same solution as Month-End step 5) (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
42Performance Reporting · Commentary Preparation · step 1Step change · AIFirst-pass commentary drafted from the driver table
An agent drafts the commentary per P&L area from the extracted variance values and the timing / structural tag, in the agreed commentary standard, and routes it to the analyst for validation (register RHY-04, RHY-12, FPA-12).		Copilot Studio agent; Python driver extract; Power Apps commentary captureManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunitySame solution as the AI agent for the draft MI Pack commentary (Month-End step 5), provided the planning assumptions are visible (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
43Performance Reporting · Commentary Preparation · step 2Step change · AutomationLean P&L view linked into the MI Pack
The Lean P&L view is embedded from the Power BI app into the MI Pack template instead of being copied manually, so the template refresh covers every slide.		Power BI embedded visuals; PowerPointAutomated → AutomatedImplementedImplemented (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
44Performance Reporting · Commentary Preparation · step 3Step change · AIOne commentary template and an evidence check before the site pack is issued
Every site pack uses one commentary header and line format (sign, unit, Fav / Adv) and the drafted commentary is checked against the dashboard measures, comparator and thresholds before publication (register RHY-27, FPA-23).		Master MI Pack template; AI evidence checker (Python + LLM); Power BISemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be exploredCan be explored (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
45Performance Reporting · MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional) · step 1Step change · AINatural-language Q&A on the pack during the EF review
EF and the analyst query the governed dashboard in natural language during the review (which function drove the manpower increase, which comparator explains the variance) with cited measures, cutting the waiting time between review rounds (register FPA-11).		Power BI Copilot / Q&A; Site Cost & FTE dashboardManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityDo-able for actual data, as SAP posting details are available for Q&A with the right prompts; variance analysis versus planning is limited at this stage (see Month-End step 5) (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
46Performance Reporting · MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional) · step 2Step change · DigitalizationSign-off and pre-read evidence captured in a workflow
The pre-read distribution and the site CFO / Head of Finance approval are captured in a Power Automate approval with the evidence stored against the period, meeting Core FSC009-001 without e-mail trails.		Power Automate approvals; SharePointManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredOngoing FAST+ project uses Power Automate to obtain the CFO / Head of Finance approval - to adopt FAST+ (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
47Performance Reporting · MI Pack Review & Sign-Off (Site and Regional) · step 3Step change · AIAgent Rhy run hardened and triggered automatically
Completeness check on the nine site packs, period / version guard, automatic trigger when the final packs land, totals tied back to the Ops P&L report and a run log with fallback route make the Rhy consolidation reliable in every close, with business judgement kept as the final review (register RHY-01, 08, 09, 11, 13, 15, 16, 21).		Agent Rhy (Copilot Studio); Power Automate; SharePoint; Power BISemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be exploredCan be explored (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
48Leadership Insights & Decision Support · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · step 1Step change · AIConsolidated APAC risks and opportunities view for leadership
Each site's R&O table (likelihood, timing, USD m) is rolled up into one regional list with the Flash, so leadership sees the forward view with the pack (register RHY-18).		Agent Rhy output; Power BIManual → Semi-automatedImplementedAgent Rhy is able to provide this (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
49Leadership Insights & Decision Support · Leadership Insights & Decision Support · step 2Step change · DigitalizationTier-meeting actions tracked on one list feeding the next pre-close
Insights and actions from the weekly tier meetings are logged on a SharePoint list linked to the site and P&L line, so the next pre-month-end checks and the next cycle start from the open actions.		SharePoint list; Teams; Power BIManual → Semi-automatedPotential future opportunityOutside GFS scope · Site CFO / RFDOutside the GFS scope; can be explored by the site CFO / RFD (LT review, 26 Oct 2026)
50Demand & Operational Inputs · Planning Inputs & Cycle Kick-off · AI opportunityDigitalizationOne planning intake for targets, volumes and system openings
A single planning intake page lists the target release, the volume publication and the system openings with their dates and owners, so every stream starts from the same published inputs.		——Not feasibleProduction volume: already implemented with one single source that published in BPP portal. For respective target to roll out (Site, Global Quality, Global Logistic, Capex): Not feasible (LT 2nd review)
51Operational Planning · CAPEX Planning · AI opportunityDigitalizationCAPEX planning intake linked to CAS
One intake for project templates with the CAS approved funding and T-code status attached, giving EF, the CAPEX analysts and the RFDs the same view of each project.		——Not feasibleThe current Capex spend-planning approach is based on CAS-approved codes, but direct linkage to CAS may not be feasible, apart from using AI to validate the CAS T-code as described in Box 2. (LT 2nd review)

Pre-close checks, the P&L Review file and the final reconciliation read one governed staging layer with automated SAP vs ASO reconciliation, removing the multi-system rebuild during close (register FPA-03, FPA-06, FPA-15).		——Not feasibleThe underlying FDH data originates from SAP/SOAR BW. Therefore, the upstream SAP/SOAR data source cannot be removed or replaced by performing the reconciliation solely within FDH (LT 2nd review)

One threshold rule set for site and market commentary so Ops and Commercial variance commentary read the same way (register RHY-29).		——Not feasibleNot feasible, as the variance thresholds are not standardised between Ops and Commercial. (LT 2nd review)

Asset retirement with sales proceeds creates significant additional workload due to extensive manual preparation of journal entries. This includes cross-checking group and local book balances, splitting sales proceeds without tax by asset lines, and performing detailed calculations for sales proceed without tax amounts to ensure accurate double-entry postings. The process is further constrained by SAP limitations, including the 990-line posting cap, which requires large transaction volumes (e.g., quarterly CN cycles with up to 1,000 assets) to be split into multiple journal entries while maintaining full reconciliation of sales and tax totals. In addition, SAP enforces a hard-stop, line-by-line validation and manual saving of system-generated entries, making the process highly time-consuming and operationally inefficient.Process and Record Fixed Asset Retirements · step 1

asIs.title: P2P As-Is Process Map
asIs.html:
Purchase To Pay · Goods & services receipt → Invoice management → Payment → Month-end close · specialist variants on the side · 5 key processes, 20 flows · final review 16 Oct 2026

P2P As-Is Process Map

How AstraZeneca makes sure we only pay suppliers for goods and services that were ordered, received, correctly invoiced, approved and paid: the purchase order, the goods receipt and the invoice are matched in Coupa, variances are approved by the business, the liability is recorded in SAP and the payment run pays the supplier on the due date. Everything else is an exception branch or a specialist variant. Updated for the final review with Ching Yee Thow and Emily Lau (16 Oct 2026).

AI solution register 61

Every suggested step change, Copilot / Agent Builder option and AI opportunity · feasibility tag and comment from the final review of 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau) · decisions on solutioning and prioritisation sit with the GPO / GPDT
#WhereKindSuggestionToolsActivity type
As-Is → if adopted		FeasibilityRegister / LT comments
1Goods & services receipt · Goods / service receipt · step 3Step changePost the receipt - GR nudge and pre-filled receipt
Celonis / Coupa flags invoices waiting in Pending receipt and nudges the requisitioner automatically (Teams / email, escalating by ageing to the line manager). The receipt is pre-filled from the PO line and the delivery note so the receiver only confirms the quantity.		Celonis action flow or Coupa notification; Power Automate / Teams; delivery-note OCR (Kofax)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAutomated reminder emails for pending receipts are already in place; pre-filling or performing the receipt is not - the requester must still confirm the physical receipt (control). Under exploration by the global P2P team.
2Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 2Step changeRoute to the CIR mailbox / scan paper invoice
An AI mailbox triage reads the CIR mailbox: it separates invoices from other mail, lifts the accounting codes and budget-holder details the requestor supplied, and bounces invalid file types / sizes back to the sender automatically, so step 2a disappears for most cases.		LLM email classifier (Azure OpenAI / Copilot Studio); Power Automate; Kofax import connectorSemi-automated → Semi-automatedImplementedAlready part of the design: invoices sent to the CIR mailbox are captured by the system and generated as invoice documents into Kofax.
3Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 2aStep changeNotify the supplier to resend
Auto-reply with the accepted formats and size limit; AP only sees repeat failures.		Power Automate; mailbox rulesManual → AutomatedCan be exploredKofax may support automated notifications, but AP still manages the discarded emails; supplier details and the current configuration need to be validated.
4Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 3Step changeKofax OCR extracts and validates the invoice
Add an LLM extraction layer for unstructured invoices: line-item descriptions are matched to PO lines by meaning rather than exact text, and low-confidence fields are routed to AP (step 4) instead of failing the match.		Kofax + LLM document extraction (Azure Document Intelligence / GPT); Coupa PO line dataAutomated → AutomatedCan be exploredOCR extraction is in place; the LLM layer to match line items by meaning (low-confidence cases routed to AP) is the new part - to be explored.
5Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 4Step changeAP verifies and completes the extracted data
AP reviews only the fields below the confidence threshold; high-confidence invoices pass straight to Coupa. Kofax-to-Coupa transmission is monitored on a dashboard rather than by a daily manual check.		Kofax confidence scores; Celonis / Power BI transmission monitorManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredConfidence-based review (e.g. 80% threshold for straight-through) can be explored; the transmission monitoring belongs after the export, and the Celonis dashboard already exists.
6Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 4Copilot agent optionCopilot in Outlook / Kofax queue
Copilot drafts the query to the supplier or requester for the fields that could not be extracted, from the invoice image and the PO.		Copilot in Outlook / Kofax queueManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
7Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel) · step 5aStep changeRaise a ServiceNow ticket and resolve
Interface monitoring detects Kofax-Coupa failures and raises the ServiceNow incident with the invoice reference automatically; AP tracks the resolution.		Celonis / interface monitoring; ServiceNow APIManual → Semi-automatedNot relevantA ServiceNow ticket is raised only after the team validates that the integration failure is technical; automatic ticket creation is not relevant. Transmission monitoring (Celonis dashboard) is already implemented.
8Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 1aStep changeException - missing information or hold
An agent completes missing invoice details from the PO, supplier record and remit-to master, maps the remit-to address and proposes the hold release; AP approves the proposal instead of keying the data.		Coupa API; vendor master (DMT); LLM agentManual → Semi-automatedImplementedCovered by the global non-PO project that just went live.
9Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 2aStep changeException - missing receipt
Automated GR chaser: the requestor is reminded on a schedule with the PO and invoice attached and escalated by ageing; AP steps in only when the chaser fails.		Coupa notifications; Power Automate / Teams; Celonis ageingSemi-automated → Semi-automatedImplementedCoupa notifications and the team script already chase missing receipts; the global P2P receipt initiative covers the rest.
10Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa · step 2bStep changeException - price variance (On Hold)
A variance assistant explains the difference (price list, contract, FX, quantity) and auto-accepts variances within policy; AP decides only the residual cases.		Coupa; contract / price-list data; LLM assistantManual → Semi-automatedNot relevantCoupa standard: price variances within the approved threshold are auto-approved and the variance assistant already states whether the PO unit price or the total is off.
11Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 1Step changeApprover reviews the invoice in Coupa
The approver receives a one-paragraph variance summary (what differs from the PO, why, policy position) with a recommended action. Harmonise the over-delivery tolerance between Coupa and SAP Direct Materials so the same invoice is not blocked twice.		Coupa approval to-do + LLM summary; tolerance master alignment (Coupa / SAP)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredNice to have, low impact. The Coupa / SAP over-delivery tolerance difference is a known S/4 issue, not a separate AI solution.
12Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 1Copilot agent optionCopilot in Coupa / Outlook
Copilot summarises what differs from the PO and the policy position for the approver, instead of a one-paragraph summary built into Coupa.		Copilot in Coupa / OutlookManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
13Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting · step 2aStep changeException - SAP posting error
Posting errors are classified by type; known types (missing WHT code, blocked vendor, closed period) trigger the fix request to DMT / Ops IT and the re-push (Exported = No) automatically. AP handles only unknown errors.		Coupa-SAP error log; rules + LLM classifier; ServiceNow APIManual → Semi-automatedImplementedSAP already shows the posting error message; the remaining effort is AP investigation of the message - part of the existing design.
14Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · step 2Step changeInvestigate and assess the resolution
A failure root-cause classifier (invalid characters, bank details, format, system) proposes whether a re-run or a manual payment is needed.		SAP F110 log; rules / ML classifierManual → Semi-automatedImplementedPayment-failure handling is covered by the Cash & Banking PSPC initiative; SAP shows the high-level failure and AP / Cash & Banking judge re-run vs manual payment. Ownership to confirm with Cash & Banking / O2C.
15Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · step 2Copilot agent optionCopilot in Excel / Outlook
Copilot drafts the investigation note from the SAP failure message and the vendor master, for AP and Cash & Banking to decide on re-run vs manual payment.		Copilot in Excel / OutlookManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
16Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments · step 3Step changeReverse the payment document and raise the manual payment request
The manual payment request in CROWN is pre-filled from the SAP document (payment details, supporting documents, root cause) for the Payment Processor to confirm.		CROWN; SAP; Power AutomateManual → Semi-automatedUnder reviewCROWN is being replaced by Cash & Banking; the pre-filled request depends on the new tool.
17Payment · Flow 3 - Exception: rejected payments (before and after funds release) · step 2Step changeBlock the invoice, troubleshoot and resolve
Bank-detail and vendor-master validation (IBAN / SWIFT format, country rules) runs before the next payment run and proposes the correction to DMT.		Vendor master validation service; bank format rules; DMT request APIManual → Semi-automatedImplementedMDG already validates the bank details (IBAN, bank name, format) before DMT maintains them in SAP - implemented upfront, not before the payment run.
18Payment · Flow 3 - Exception: rejected payments (before and after funds release) · step 2Agent Builder optionAgent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)
An agent grounded on the rejection reasons and the bank-detail rules lists the likely cause and the correction for AP before the invoice is unblocked.		Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
19Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changes · step 1aStep changeBusiness and P2P Ops approval
Drive the ServiceNow approval matrix from the DOA / HR hierarchy master so it maintains itself; approvals route automatically and every change is audited.		ServiceNow; Workday / DOA master integrationManual → AutomatedNot relevantThe right procurement leaders cannot be identified from the HR hierarchy today.
20Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changes · step 2Step changeAP reviews the approvals and adjusts the payment date
Once approved, the Days field update in SAP (FB02) is applied by the workflow and the ticket closes automatically.		ServiceNow workflow; SAP RPA / BAPIManual → AutomatedCan be exploredMinimal impact; the workflow calculation of the payment days and the ownership need to be validated.
21Payment · Flow 5 - Exception: incoming funds · step 1Step changeNotification of incoming funds
Incoming funds are matched to the supplier automatically from remittance text, amount and open credits (the same ML matching pattern as O2C cash application); unmatched items are listed for AP with the best candidates.		Bank statement / Lockbox data; ML matching (BlackLine-style); SAPManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredCash & Banking process - ownership of the incoming-funds posting to be confirmed with Cash & Banking (Angie) before this is taken further.
22Payment · Flow 5 - Exception: incoming funds · step 2Step changeBook the item in SAP
Matched items are posted automatically (F42 / FB01) with the proposed account; AP books only the unmatched residue.		SAP BAPI / RPAManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredCash & Banking books the items it can identify; the automatic proposal would cover the unmatched residue - to confirm with Cash & Banking (Angie).
23Payment · Flow 6 - Control: duplicate payment monitoring (Xelix) · step 2Step changeAP examines each case
Extend duplicate detection to down payments (special GL items) and non-invoice payments, and use the Xelix outcome history to auto-release known false positives.		Xelix configuration; SAP special GL dataManual → Semi-automatedUnder reviewXelix already covers down payments; the high-risk scenarios (e.g. invoice posted before the down payment) are under review.
24Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 1Step changeSet the Coupa interface cut-off in SAP
Schedule the Coupa interface cut-off from the month-end calendar (one variant per company code) instead of keying the dates.		SAP job scheduling (/n/AZGWS/COUPA_PDT2 variant)Manual → AutomatedUnder reviewMonth-end interface cut-off scheduling is in progress.
25Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 2Step changePosting-error population moves to Coupa P2P / R2R scope
Coupa AP approved items move to Coupa P2P and leave the non-PO accrual population (P2P feedback on NPO-09). Approved-but-not-posted items are accrued once, under the ownership agreed between P2P and R2R (NPO-19, NPO-20).		Coupa P2P; R2R AJD stuck-invoice accrualManual → AutomatedUnder reviewTPI Non-PO Accrual NPO-09 / NPO-26: Coupa AP approved items move to Coupa P2P.
26Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 3Step changeExtract non-PO invoices pending in Coupa (Celonis)
The Python asset already built pulls the Celonis Non PO Account Allocation extract on schedule (NPO-01); Celonis stays the data source (P2P feedback on NPO-12 / NPO-34).		Celonis Coupa Control Tower; Python scriptSemi-automated → AutomatedImplementedTPI NPO-01: the Python script that pulls the Celonis extract on schedule is already built.
27Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 4Step changeConsolidate and apply the exclusion criteria
The Python script consolidates the extracts and applies the exclusion logic held as versioned, machine-readable rules with an audit trail (NPO-10). Milestone-based accruals read the percentage of completion from Veeva / WorkMate (NPO-02); the country-level data crunch (NPO-07) decides which population survives the elimination decision.		Python; rules engine; Veeva / WorkMate integration; manual journal dashboard (NPO-04)Manual → AutomatedUnder reviewTPI NPO-10 (exclusion logic as a rules engine) - feasible per the register, not yet started.
28Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 5Step changeRaise the accrual journal in BlackLine
The journal is prepared by the script and pre-validated against BlackLine master data (GL, cost centre, internal order) before import, so the re-upload loop disappears (NPO-11). Straight-through posting (NPO-17 pattern) to be reassessed with R2R for China per P2P feedback.		Python; BlackLine import / API; master-data validationManual → AutomatedUnder reviewTPI NPO-11 (journal pre-validation against BlackLine master data) - feasible per the register, not yet started.
29Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6) · step 6Step changeChina: contribution accrual and pre-payment offsetting
Automate the China contribution accrual on WorkMate with R2R by August 2026 and handle the pre-payment offsetting inside the automation so the separate step disappears (NPO-05, NPO-06); reuse the China commitment-report dashboard already in build (NPO-03).		WorkMate; R2R posting; Controllership commitment dashboardManual → AutomatedUnder reviewTPI NPO-05 / NPO-06: China contribution accrual automation on WorkMate with R2R.
30Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 1Step changeExtract the control reports
Control reports are extracted on schedule (SAP job scheduling / Celonis export) into the control workspace.		SAP job scheduling; Celonis; SharePointSemi-automated → AutomatedImplementedControl reports are already extracted with Celonis and Python.
31Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 2Step changeExecute the controls per the mini-SOX SOP
A control assistant runs the mini-SOX SOP checks over the extracted reports and drafts the control result for AP to confirm; exceptions are listed with their evidence.		Python / Power Automate; LLM assistant over the SOPManual → Semi-automatedNot relevantControl execution needs human validation of the exceptions.
32Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 2Agent Builder optionAgent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)
An agent grounded on the mini-SOX SOP walks the control steps and drafts the control result for the preparer to validate - the exceptions stay with AP.		Agent Builder agent (Microsoft 365 Copilot)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
33Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reporting · step 3Step changeSubmit the control file and evidence in OneGRC
System-generated evidence (record counts, run manifest, time-stamped extracts) replaces screenshots and is uploaded to OneGRC by workflow.		OneGRC upload; run manifestsManual → Semi-automatedImplementedEvidence extraction is automated with Python; the scripts can still fail when line items exceed the predefined rules - to be raised with the COE Digital team.
34Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 1Step changeUpdate the GL checklist
The GL checklist is driven from the BlackLine and GL master (BSR-13 - future; companies not on BlackLine still to be understood) and carries the company code + GL account list, so onboarding an entity is a data change, not a code change (BSR-19 - feasible).		BlackLine / GL master; GL checklist file as configurationManual → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-13 / BSR-19: GL checklist driven from the BlackLine / GL master; configuration-driven company-code onboarding raised in the retro.
35Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 2Step changeExtract the SAP balance and open-item reports
SAP job scheduling runs the extraction server-side on predefined variants, removing individual SAP access and the screen-coordinate dependency (BSR-02, BSR-11 - feasible). One shared extraction service can serve BSR, non-PO accrual and other towers if the templates align (BSR-32). Reading from Snowflake is not pursued (BSR-14 feedback); what already sits there is to be assessed (BSR-28).		SAP job scheduling; shared extraction serviceSemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-02 / BSR-11: SAP job scheduling replaces GUI extraction - raised in session.
36Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 3Step changePrepare the reconciliation from the entity template
One common automation framework on a standardised BlackLine template (BSR-01, BSR-03) runs on a centralised, governed VM (BSR-04; request via DevOps, BSR-25) with scheduling, logging and alerting (BSR-05), version control (BSR-06) and a central SharePoint repository (BSR-08); coverage extends to the remaining 582 GL account assignments (BSR-07) and the design anticipates Axial / S/4HANA (BSR-10).		Python framework; central VM; SharePoint repositorySemi-automated → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-01 / 03 / 04-08: common template and framework on a centralised VM - raised in session.
37Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 3aStep changeFix or rerun the script; prepare manually
A central Power BI run dashboard shows status, failures and SLA adherence per company code (BSR-17 - feasible); a documented continuity plan with SOPs, two trained backup owners, manual fallback and a one-business-day recovery objective (BSR-09).		Power BI run dashboard; SOP / BCPManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-17: central run dashboard - feasible per the register.
38Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 4Step changeWrite the commentary for open items and debit balances
Anomaly detection flags unusual ageing, debit balances on payables and unexpected movements before the SME opens the pack (BSR-16 - feasible). AI-drafted commentary for the SME to edit is a later step once enough data supports the logic (BSR-15 - future, P2P feedback).		Anomaly model over open items; LLM commentary draft (future)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-16 (anomaly detection, feasible) and BSR-15 (AI commentary, future).
39Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 4Copilot agent optionCopilot in Excel
Copilot drafts the commentary on open items and debit balances from the ageing and prior-period comments, for the preparer to confirm.		Copilot in ExcelManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
40Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 5Step changeCapture the control evidence
System-generated evidence replaces screenshots: the SAP-team HTML extract carries the export time stamp, plus record counts, control totals and the run manifest (BSR-12 - feasible); one evidence and control standard across towers (BSR-33).		Run manifests; SAP HTML extract time stampManual → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-12 / BSR-33: system-generated evidence - feasible per the register.
41Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR) · step 6Step changeUpload the reconciliation to BlackLine
Standard packs are submitted through the BlackLine API just obtained (BSR-18 - future, together with BSR-13); one combined P2P + R2R BlackLine report at the lowest granularity serves both towers (BSR-26).		BlackLine APIManual → AutomatedCan be exploredTPI BSR-18 / BSR-26: BlackLine API submission - future; API standard to be aligned across towers.
42Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 1Step changeValidate the invoice and payment nature
A WHT determination assistant classifies the payment nature from the invoice text, contract and supplier profile and proposes applicability and code per the market SOP.		LLM classifier; market WHT rule set (Tax)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredThe WHT process is subjective (payment nature, supporting documents) and it is not confirmed that Coupa can take an additional AI layer; not covered by the global non-PO project.
43Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 1Copilot / Microsoft AI optionCopilot Studio agent
An agent classifies the payment nature from the invoice text and the supporting documents and proposes the WHT applicability for AP to confirm.		Copilot Studio agentManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
44Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 2Step changeCheck the WHT code in the vendor master
Vendor-master WHT codes are checked for completeness and consistency against the market rule set before the invoice arrives; gaps go to DMT as a maintenance request.		SAP vendor master; DMT request APIManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredThe whole WHT validation can be further explored with the Tax WHT engine work.
45Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 1 - Withholding tax (WHT) validation before posting · step 4Step changeValidate the WHT calculation
The Vietnam fractional and Korea partial-exemption calculations run in a validated calculator (WHT engine) rather than off-system spreadsheets, writing the WHT base and amount back to Coupa.		WHT engine (Tax Miro deck, TAX-01 target)Manual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredThe whole WHT validation can be further explored with the Tax WHT engine work.
46Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice payments · step 3Step changeAP posts the down payment in SAP
The approved Coupa down-payment form posts the F-47 request in SAP automatically and writes the SAP reference and payment date back to Coupa.		Coupa form to SAP integration / RPA (F-47)Manual → AutomatedCan be exploredCoupa custom form (Others): the extraction and SAP posting would need a bot / RPA or an integration - Celonis cannot post. China already posts automatically through iPay (Variant 2b).
47Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice payments · step 6Step changeClear the down payment against the final invoice
When the final invoice posts, the down payment is proposed for clearing (F-54 / F-44) by matching PO, vendor and amount; partial clearings are proposed with the difference for AP to confirm.		SAP matching rule / RPAManual → Semi-automatedUnder reviewAutomation of the down payment clearing is currently being explored by AP (not the payment-method-M clearing).
48Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 3 - Direct debits · step 3Step changeSupplier submits the invoice; AP processes it
An invoice chaser is triggered when a debit entry is posted without a matching invoice: the supplier / requestor is reminded with the debit details and escalated by ageing.		SAP debit entries; Power Automate / emailSemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be exploredSuppliers do not always submit the invoice promptly after the debit - the chaser can be explored.
49Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 3 - Direct debits · step 3Copilot agent optionCopilot in Outlook
Copilot drafts the invoice chaser to the supplier / requester from the debit entry details.		Copilot in OutlookSemi-automated → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAdded 18 Oct 2026; licensing and governance to be confirmed
50Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 3 - Direct debits · step 4Step changeInvoice posted; debit cleared
Debit entries are matched and cleared against the posted invoice automatically on vendor, amount and date; AP clears only the residue.		SAP automatic clearing (F.13) rulesManual → Semi-automatedCan be exploredAutomatic matching and clearing of the debit against the posted invoice can be explored.
51Goods & services receipt · Goods / service receiptAutomationGR ageing monitor and nudge agent
Monitor POs with invoices waiting in Pending receipt, nudge the requisitioner and escalate by ageing; report GR lead time by market against the P2P KPIs (Payment to Terms, Invoice TAT).		——ImplementedThe GR reminder is already in place (Coupa notifications, email reminders, team script); the global P2P team is exploring the receipt-related AI use cases.
52Invoice management · Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel)AITouchless capture for unstructured invoices
LLM extraction and semantic matching on top of Kofax with confidence-based routing; target: most PDF and email invoices reach Coupa with no AP touch.		——Can be exploredLLM extraction and semantic matching on top of the existing OCR - to be explored; Kofax itself is being replaced by a new global tool.
53Invoice management · Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in CoupaAIException-resolution agent for Coupa holds
One agent works the Draft, AP Hold, Booking Hold and Pending receipt queues: proposes the fix, chases the right person and releases within policy; AP supervises by exception.		——ImplementedCovered by the global non-PO project (just live), the existing Coupa notifications and the Coupa variance threshold.
54Invoice management · Flow 3 - Approval and SAP postingAutomationPosting-error auto-remediation
Classify Coupa-to-SAP posting errors, auto-apply the known fix and re-push, and feed error patterns back to DMT master-data quality.		——ImplementedSAP posting error messages are part of the existing design; AP investigates from the message.
55Payment · Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency paymentsAutomationPayment-failure triage
Classify payment-run failures, pre-fill the manual payment request and track the vendor clearing (F-44) so the exception closes without re-keying.		——ImplementedPayment-failure handling sits with Cash & Banking (PSPC initiative) - to confirm with Cash & Banking / O2C.
56Payment · Flow 4 - Exception: early payment requests and payment date changesAutomationStraight-through early payment requests
Policy-based auto-approval, approval matrix from the DOA master and automated payment-date change in SAP.		——Can be exploredLow impact; the approval matrix part is not relevant, the SAP days update can be explored.
57Month-end closeProcess ImprovementOne accrual ownership model across P2P, R2R, Controlling and FP&A Ops
Agree who accrues what (pending approval vs approved-not-posted vs ad hoc vs departmental), close the Coupa AP vs Coupa P2P scope question, bring Controlling and FP&A Ops into the design, revisit the non-PO guideline as the root lever and take the continue / stop decision to local finance with the data.		——Under reviewTPI NPO-19 / 20 / 21 / 27: accrual ownership across the towers.
58Month-end close · Flow 1 - STP cut-off and non-PO accrual (APAC WD-3; China WD-6)AutomationSystem-generated non-PO accruals (target Q1 2027)
Once the common global framework and RACI are agreed (Nov-Dec 2026), accruals are generated by the system from Coupa / Celonis data with controller review; the Python asset is the bridge until then.		——Under reviewTPI NPO-08: system-generated accruals from Q1 2027 once the framework and RACI are agreed.
59Month-end close · Flow 2 - SOX / FCF self-assessment and reportingAIControl execution assistant
Runs the SOP-defined checks over scheduled extracts, drafts the control result and packages system-generated evidence for OneGRC.		——Not relevantControl execution needs human validation.
60Month-end close · Flow 3 - AP balance sheet reconciliation (BSR)AutomationShared automation platform for all towers
The VM, repository, governance, run dashboard, coverage inventory and training pack built for P2P BSR serve O2C, Controlling and Tax too (BSR-30 feasible; BSR-31, BSR-34, BSR-35); align with the R2R-led global BSR programme and adopt what R2R has built (BSR-21, BSR-22), with GPO / GPDD endorsement (BSR-23), Genpact (BSR-27) and named regional owners (BSR-29).		——Can be exploredTPI BSR-30 / 31 / 32 / 35: the framework offered to all towers - feasible per the register.
61Specialist variants (branch from the core invoice journey) · Variant 2 - Down payments and non-invoice paymentsAutomationDown payment straight-through

asIs.html:
Order to Cash · Order to Invoice, Collections and Banking · Sales order creation, Order block release, Billing, Collections & disputes, Payment allocation, Cash & Banking

Order to Cash As-Is Process Map

Convert distributor EDI sales, customer purchase orders, returns and rebates into valid SAP sales orders or credit notes, then release blocked orders, bill them and collect payment; apply the cash received to customer accounts in High Radius, run outgoing payments and post the bank statements through to the bank reconciliation in BlackLine, handed to R2R Reporting for month-end close.

ai.title: AI opportunities 14
ai.html:
AI opportunities 14

Shown as blue nodes on the map · Claude recommendations and TPI register patterns · hypotheses to validate
DigitalizationOrder-to-invoice exception dashboard by market and cause
Phase · Sales order creation · O2C-01 - Claude recommendation

Bring EDI errors, manual-order exceptions and order blocks from SAP into one Power BI view by market, customer and root cause (account, price, stock, VAT, credit) so the Sales Order, Credit Risk and Billing teams fix master data and credit settings instead of case-by-case follow-up.

AutomationAuto-triage EDI order errors to the resolving team
Flow · Sales order creation · Flow 1 - EDI orders (automatic) · O2C-01.02 - Claude recommendation

A scheduled script extracts the daily EDI order error log from SAP, classifies each error (missing end-customer account, missing price, insufficient stock) and raises it to DMT / Distribution, the market and Controlling, or Distribution with a tracked status - replacing email follow-up by the Sales Order team.

DigitalizationPre-creation VAT master-data validation
Flow · Sales order creation · Flow 2 - Customer PO, returns and rebates (manual) · O2C-01.02 - Claude recommendation

Before an order or credit note is created, check the VAT classification against SAP master data and flag mismatches to local market, stopping incorrect VAT at invoice.

AIPredictive credit-block reduction for CNXX markets
Phase · Order block release · O2C-01.03 - Claude recommendation

Use twelve months of block, release and payment history to recommend credit-limit adjustments for customers repeatedly blocked but paying on time, for Credit Risk approval - reducing the volume of blocks at source alongside the Banker's Acceptance exclusion.

AutomationRelease-on-approval workflow with evidence trail
Flow · Order block release · Order block release (manual orders) · O2C-01.03 - Claude recommendation

One workflow for the three block reasons: the blocked order generates the approval request with the exposure summary, routes it to the GDOA 2002 / Credit Risk Policy / GDOA 2000 approver, stores the evidence and triggers the SAP release by script.

AutomationE-invoice submission and status monitoring
Flow · Billing · Billing (invoices, credit notes, e-invoicing) · O2C-01.06 - Claude recommendation

Automatic submission of SAP billing data to each mandated tax-authority portal, status write-back to SAP and a rejection queue by market, so new e-invoicing mandates are onboarded as configuration rather than new manual steps.

DigitalizationOverpayment and refund tracker (China aged overpayments)
Phase · Collections & disputes management · O2C-02.01 - Claude recommendation

Age customer overpayments in High Radius / SAP, trigger the refund request to Cash & Banking once the market criteria are met and report aged balances by customer, replacing manual follow-up of China overpayments.

AIPredictive payment-risk scoring
Flow · Collections & disputes management · Collection - payment follow-up and escalation · O2C-02.01 - Claude recommendation

Score open invoices by likelihood of late payment from High Radius history (customer, market, past commitments kept) to focus pre-due calls on the invoices most at risk and recommend when to escalate.

AutomationDeduction-to-credit-note matching
Flow · Collections & disputes management · Disputes and deductions management · O2C-02.01 - Claude recommendation

Match customer deductions taken on payment to open or approved claims (returns, rebates, AP-due invoices) before the credit note is issued, so valid deductions clear on posting and invalid ones return to collections with the evidence attached.

DigitalizationAuto-match rate monitoring by market and unmatched reason
Flow · Payment allocation / cash application · Payment allocation - matched payments · O2C-02.04 - Claude recommendation

A Power BI view of the High Radius auto-match rate by market and the reason for each unmatched payment (no remittance, lump sum, advance, short-pay) so rule tuning and customer remittance requests target the biggest causes.

AutomationPayment-to-bank-to-ledger reconciliation
Phase · Cash & Banking · O2C-03 - TPI register ICT-13

Match each payment request, payment instruction, bank confirmation and accounting entry automatically and route only the breaks for investigation - covering the automated run, manual payments and the bank statement in one control.

AutomationPre-payment beneficiary and duplicate validation
Flow · Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: automated / semi-automated payment run · O2C-03.01 - TPI register ICT-11 / ICT-12

Validate beneficiary bank details, currency, amount limits and approver authority against governed masters and check for duplicate payments before the file is released, so rejections and re-issues fall at source.

DigitalizationManual payment status and exception dashboard
Flow · Cash & Banking · Flow A - Payment process: manual payment route · O2C-03.01 - TPI register ICT-14

Show each Crown request's age, approval stage, payment status, cut-off risk and rejection reason in one view for the Cash & Banking team and requesters, replacing status emails.

DigitalizationOpen-item ageing and ownership dashboard
Flow · Cash & Banking · Flow B - Bank statement process · O2C-03.02 - TPI register PAY-10 pattern applied to bank open items

One reconciled list of bank open items by category, stakeholder, age and status (payroll, T&E, vendor refunds, unidentified) so the follow-up is worked from a single view and aged items are visible before month-end.

asIs.title: Controlling As-Is Process Map
asIs.html:
Controlling · Manual Journal Preparation (MJV) → Statutory Reporting & Audit · the two key processes Controlling has documented; other Controlling processes named in the MIRO feedback are listed at the bottom

Controlling As-Is Process Map

Two questions for the visitor: how does GFS Controlling make sure every judgmental manual journal posted in the month-end close is needed, GSOP-compliant, approved and reviewed in the management P&L, and how does it get the statutory audit from planning to filed accounts across all the process towers each year? The answer is the journey below - the Business requests, Embedded Finance approves the cost, the GFS Controller checks the GSOP and posts in BlackLine, the GFS Manager approves and GFS FP&A reviews the P&L; the audit runs from planning and walkthroughs through PBC evidence, fieldwork, financial statement review and P13 adjustments to statutory filing. Pain points and TPI 2026 initiatives are shown where Controlling recorded them.
